A FEW WAYS IN

Follow your curiosity.

Drag or tap near mass 1 to set its release offset. Left/right changes coupling; up/down changes damping. Space cycles One mass, In phase, and Opposite releases. R replays the same release. Changing any slider starts again from rest; zero offset is equilibrium. P pauses; every control works while paused. Reduced motion starts paused. No audio is produced. Color and PNG export are available.

The mathematics

Two unit masses sit between fixed walls, attached to identical outer springs k and a central coupling κ. The symmetric and antisymmetric coordinates have squared natural angular frequencies k and k + 2κ. Their exact damped solutions determine every position and velocity, including critical and overdamped cases. Weak coupling produces beats. The two bars show each mass’s kinetic and outer-spring energy plus half of the coupling energy, relative to the initial total. Damping removes energy; without damping the total is conserved. The graph shows twelve seconds of exact displacement curves; its marker is the current time. Colors identify masses 1 and 2. Units are normalized and the drawn spring shapes are illustrative.
